title: Wall Mount Two-Tiered Glass Shelf 16-Inch Solid Brass | Modern Square Bathroom Hardware | Allied Brass
description:
Maximize your storage with the Montero 16-inch two-tiered glass shelf, an elegant bathroom rack designed for contemporary spaces. This wall-mounted vanity shelving unit features a bold architectural style with square hardware, making it a perfect match for minimalist and geometric decor. Built with premium solid brass and thick tempered glass, it offers a sturdy platform for bathroom essentials without cluttering your countertops.

Highlights:
- Two-tier shelving doubles your storage capacity in a compact footprint
- Crafted from high-quality solid brass for rust-resistant performance
- Safety-tempered glass with beveled edges for a refined look
- Easy wall-mount installation with included hardware and concealed screws
- Designed to coordinate with other Montero collection bathroom accessories

Specifications:
- Size: 16-In Length x 8.3-In Height
- Materials: Genuine Brass and 3/8-In Tempered Glass
- Capacity: 4 lb weight limit
- Origin: Assembled in the USA
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
